custom_image.note: your own image, supervised by the platform: its entrypoint never runs (the platform keeps the node alive for run_command), and only the home path survives stops - everything else resets every wake

provisioning.estimate_basis: already provisioning; spin-up from 2 cpu-8 create samples
provisioning.note: a start that stops progressing is bounded: the platform cancels it and returns the node to the queue (position kept) or fails it with the reason under last_failure; delete_node cancels a stuck create immediately.
